source.inspection: Complete shallow clone of the pinned commit; every tracked file was enumerated.

measured_on.note: Results are recorded in skills/procedural-3d-blender/references/version-compatibility.md and research/blender-skills-review.md.

change_tags.guide-from-skill-body: Upstream SKILL.md body kept as a reference guide; its frontmatter and title were replaced by a pack title.
change_tags.provenance-header: A provenance line naming the upstream path, commit and license was added under the title.
change_tags.skill-names-remapped: Upstream skill names were replaced by the owning pack skill (see skill_map).
change_tags.links-rebased: Relative links and reference paths were rebased to the guide's new location.
change_tags.routing-table-rewritten: The upstream routing table was replaced by one that names pack skills and adds pack-only owners.
change_tags.split: One upstream file was divided between two pack skills; each part keeps the upstream wording of its sections.
change_tags.blender-5.1-compat: Changed so the file works on Blender releases older than 5.2 (see version-compatibility.md).
change_tags.no-bytecode: Changed so running it leaves no __pycache__ in installed skill directories.
change_tags.pack-layout: Paths and imports follow the Skill Foundry directory layout.
change_tags.version-gates: Tests that need a newer Blender than the one running are reported as SKIP with the required version.
